item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00010","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C03","C14","C04"],"selected_candidate_label":"C03","confidence":0.94,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C03 plausibly supplied a concrete template for protecting Federal employees who leave for an international organization. It contains the same distinctive machinery later elaborated in the child: treating the employee as on Federal leave, imposing a three-year period, preserving status during international-organization employment, and conditioning benefits on subsequent Federal reemployment. C14 is also a meaningful analogue for reemployment and status protections following outside service, while C04 parallels the Commission-administered reemployment framework and the formulation concerning a position of equal seniority, status, and pay. C03 is substantially closer to the child's specific international-organization and three-year leave structure.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"During such reemployment period, the employee shall be considered as on leave without pay for retirement and insurance purposes","parent_excerpt":"Any employee so transferred shall, for a period not to exceed three years from the date of transfer and while employed by the said international organization, be considered as being on leave of absence from his employment by the Federal Government","explanation":"Both use deemed Federal leave status to preserve the rights of an employee working for an international organization."},{"child_excerpt":"in the event of his death during the first three consecutive years of his employment with the Agency","parent_excerpt":"for a period not to exceed three years from the date of transfer and while employed by the said international organization","explanation":"The distinctive three-year protection period is carried into the child and adapted to employment with the International Atomic Energy Agency."},{"child_excerpt":"Provided ... during the re-employment period ... re-employed pursuant to section 6 (a) of the Act","parent_excerpt":"Provided, that the employee is subsequently reemployed by the Federal Government in accordance with section 3 of this order","explanation":"Both link preservation of Federal employment benefits or status to a subsequent exercise of Federal reemployment rights."}]}
